response.sql: WITH order_executions_avg AS (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS order_avg_fill FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan), timespan_avg AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(order_avg_fill) AS timespan_avg_fill FROM order_executions_avg WHERE order_avg_fill IS NOT NULL GROUP BY timespan), filtered AS (SELECT oea.ordersmark, oea.timespan, oea.order_avg_fill, oea.order_avg_fill - ta.timespan_avg_fill AS above_timespan_avg FROM order_executions_avg oea JOIN timespan_avg ta ON oea.timespan = ta.timespan WHERE oea.order_avg_fill > ta.timespan_avg_fill), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, order_avg_fill, above_timespan_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY order_avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_timespan FROM filtered) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, order_avg_fill, above_timespan_avg, rank_within_timespan FROM ranked WHERE rank_within_timespan <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rank_within_timespan
